content.text: 3Ben WattersHe is more than this. Pitino has rebuilt every team he has coached. These turn around did not takes years but happens fast.6Joseph DevannaIf you gotta get it done in 10 seconds or less, he's your guy8Scott ManningWhat would you find more impressive: Final Fours at 3 different programs (Sweet 16s at 4, Tourneys with 6) or staying at Kentucky for the last 30 years with uninterrupted continuity for 4-5 titles? Cause that’s very possible to have happened.3Jamaal SulaimanWe go way back to Kentucky and the Monster Mash days.8Alan SacksRick Pitino is the best Coach I have ever seen. He has done more with less than any other coach by a mile that you want to stack him up against. This St. John’s team would be absolutely awful if anybody else in the country was coaching them. I mean less than .500……and I’m a St.John’s fan. Look back at all the teams he has taken deep in the tourney. He’s had very few stars, and I don’t believe he has ever had two stars on any of his teams. He is truly a great college coach!22Kevin WatersNope ! I have him in the Elite 8. Everywhere he's been. He has been a winner. Calipari can only win when he is paying players. Now, it's an even playing field. You have to coach now.2Brian BurbaSaw him coach providence in old freedom Hall in NCAA he beat Georgetown and I think Alabama with mid level talent. Amazing coach one of the best. Hated to see him go to UK knew he would win title. Hated to see him leave U of LJoe SimpsonIzzo hasn't sniffed a championship in 26 years. Pitino still has a boulder on his shoulder.2
